items.q: What makes a bank agent scary, if not the model?
items.a: The **blast radius**: 19 million customers and **real money**.

items.q: Which four failure modes do agents add over scripts?
items.a: **Confidently wrong**, **talked into things**, and right but unhelpful or non-deterministic.

items.q: What did NatWest do before hardening the agent?
items.a: **Shrank the attack surface** with a routing funnel: filters and **deterministic rules** before any model.

items.q: Which three categories does NatWest score separately?
What did the 83% headline pass rate hide?
items.a: **97%** on happy paths but only **43%** on topic changes.
One that's **94% accurate but always confident** versus 85% and **knows when it's unsure**.

items.q: What made the LLM judge a broken instrument?
items.a: High scores with tiny spread and **near-zero correlation** with humans.

items.q: Why is the judge model part of your config?
items.a: Swapping it alone **moved scores across the threshold**; use a **different model family**.
The agent handles **live traffic** while the **scripted system still answers**.

items.q: How can NatWest undo a bad rollout fast?
items.a: **Feature flags** send everything or one backend **back to the scripted path** in seconds.
